verdict.rationale: Pylon's Support Agent docs include a dedicated Test page that lets you simulate interactions with the AI and see how it handles different questions before deployment. That directly delivers the simulated-conversation path of the story. Deployment is also opt-in per issue, so you control which customer issues the agent touches. Missing for 10: documented replay or backtesting against historical tickets, detail on the simulation tooling (batch scenarios, pass/fail evaluation), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, I test the agent against historical tickets or simulated conversations before it faces real customers

citations.quote: Simulate an interaction with the AI and see how it handles different questions.
This means you have full control of which customer issues your AI agent interacts with.
